_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fifty-third scheduled run. No new matches across 10,481 product pages on 16 serving URLs, but NOT an uneventful day. A SELLER REMOVED A CHART NAME FROM A LIVE LISTING for the second time on record. REDLANDRAN-031 was retitled this morning (the seller's own feed timestamps it 2026-11-25T08:06:30-05:00) from "Inkandeszenz(TM)", the title recorded when the case was created on 2026-11-19, to "Incandescence(TM)". "Inkandeszenz" is on the chart as Pending (Rosen Tantau KG); "Incandescence" is not on it, checked against all 273 names. The listing is STILL LIVE at HTTP 200, the URL handle still reads "inkandeszenz(TM)", the price is unchanged at USD 59.99, the product form is unchanged, and the description was rewritten with the name substituted at every mention. This is recorded as observed fact and NOT as a finding about the seller's reasons. A second screenshot was captured under the material-change rule, so the case carries both states. Like SPRINGLAND-008 since 2026-11-16, it will report as absent from matched products every run while remaining live, and must never be recorded as removed. ALSO THIS RUN: the Python Playwright binding was missing from this container image -- present on 2026-11-19 -- so the first capture attempt failed outright. Node's Playwright and the Chromium binaries were both present, so only the binding was restored (pip install, with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH pointed at the existing /opt/pw-browsers so no browser was re-downloaded). Capture then succeeded. Had there been new cases today they would have gone unphotographed until this was noticed. Xavian's Roses refused for a fifth consecutive run. Ergonzi reset for the fourth time in six runs and served in full on one re-pull.
